DAEMON.SUB_LIST: List all rootservers of this guild
DAEMON.SUB_STATUS: Show status & hardware of a rootserver
DAEMON.SUB_REGISTER: Create a new rootserver, like the wizard in the dashboard
DAEMON.OPT_HOST: Public IP address of the machine
DAEMON.OPT_FQDN: Domain name, such as node1.example.com. The daemon checks it when connecting
DAEMON.OPT_DESCRIPTION: Free text, such as provider and location
DAEMON.OPT_SFTP: Offer SFTP for your own programs like FileZilla (port 2022)
DAEMON.REGISTER_DESC:
⚠️ **The API key is shown only this once.** Copy it now.

Start the installer on the machine. Its setup dialog asks for the daemon ID, API key and bus address. The ready-made `daemon.yaml` is attached in case you prefer to place it by hand.
DAEMON.REGISTER_FOOTER: The daemon measures CPU, RAM and disk itself on first connect.
